'When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, this gets go again. Instant - {r}: This gets go again.' The grant stays on the ON_ATTACK trigger -- it is an event, not a state -- and the keyword is declared conditional so the printed GoAgain stops applying to an attack that never targeted a hero.

STILL NOT EXACT: the grant fires whenever the arcane damage is DEALT-attempted, not only when damage actually lands, so a prevented or reduced-to-zero 1 arcane still grants go again. Expressing that needs the damage effect to report how much it dealt.
